system.description: Action: release any number of Motes as a ranged (DEX + WLP) attack, 2 MP each. Each target loses (SL × 4) HP or MP per Mote — HP against Defense, MP against Magic Defense. Ignores Resistances. Motes are destroyed hit or miss.
